lines.text: While staying in Gerar, Abraham said of his wife Sarah, "She is my sister," and Abimelech had her brought to him.
God came to Abimelech in a dream and told him to return Abraham's wife, since Abraham was a king.
Early the next morning Abimelech told all his servants what had happened, and the men were terrified.
Abraham told Abimelech he feared the people would kill him because of his wife, and Sarah was his father's daughter.
Abimelech gave Abraham sheep, cattle and servants, and Abraham prayed, so God opened the wombs He had closed.
